scope: PA-006 bounded Computer Agent sequence source and regression verification

isolated_workspace_sequence.environment: automated test using a temporary workspace; not the desktop program

implementation.immutable_specs: validated typed operations frozen before preview
implementation.scope_validation: concrete plans are created and revalidated just in time after prior steps
implementation.approval: separate one-time approval for each mutating concrete plan
implementation.failure_behavior: remaining sequence invalidated; task pauses on just-in-time validation failure
implementation.resume_limitation: sequence itself is not persisted; after process restart, user must replan remaining operations

live_desktop_acceptance.reason: User requested that desktop control wait until they finish their current interaction.

limitations: All computer-agent sequence evidence in this report is automated isolated-workspace testing, not actual desktop UI acceptance.
The previous real IQ2_M vision and scheduler runs are separately recorded and do not establish GUI or PA-006 completion.
